source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ τὸν Ἀπολλῶ εἶναι ἐν Κορίνθῳ Παῦλον διελθόντα τὰ ἀνωτερικὰ μέρη ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εὑρεῖν τινας μαθητάς, εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς· Εἰ πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐλάβετε πιστεύσαντες;

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass now, while the Apollos was in Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper parts, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples, \v 2 he said also to them, If [the] Spirit Holy did you receive having believed?

en.L: Now it happened, while Apollos was in Corinth, [that] Paul, having passed through the upper regions, came to Ephesus and found some disciples, \v 2 and he said to them, "Did you receive [the] Holy Spirit when you believed?"
en.B: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul made his way through the inland regions and came down to Ephesus. There he came upon some disciples \v 2 and asked them, "When you came to believe, did you receive the Holy Spirit?"
en.R: At that time Apollos was in the city of Corinth. Paul traveled through the high country inland and came to the city of Ephesus. He found some disciples there. \v 2 He asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?"

fr.L: Or il arriva, pendant qu’Apollos était à Corinthe, que Paul, après avoir traversé les régions d’en haut, vint à Éphèse et trouva quelques disciples, \v 2 et il leur dit : « Avez-vous reçu l’Esprit Saint quand vous avez cru ? »
fr.B: Pendant qu’Apollos était à Corinthe, Paul traversa les régions de l’intérieur et descendit à Éphèse. Il y rencontra quelques disciples \v 2 et leur demanda : « Quand vous êtes devenus croyants, avez-vous reçu l’Esprit Saint ? »
fr.R: À ce moment-là, Apollos était dans la ville de Corinthe. Paul a voyagé à travers les hautes terres de l’intérieur, et il est arrivé dans la ville d’Éphèse. Il a trouvé là quelques disciples. \v 2 Il leur a demandé : « Avez-vous reçu l’Esprit Saint quand vous avez cru ? »

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras Apolos estaba en Corinto, Pablo, habiendo recorrido las regiones altas, llegó a Éfeso y encontró a algunos discípulos, \v 2 y les dijo: «¿{{plural_you:Recibieron|Recibisteis}} [el] Espíritu Santo cuando {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?».
es.B: Mientras Apolos estaba en Corinto, Pablo recorrió las regiones del interior y bajó a Éfeso. Allí se encontró con algunos discípulos \v 2 y les preguntó: «Cuando {{plural_you:llegaron|llegasteis}} a creer, ¿{{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} el Espíritu Santo?».
es.R: En ese tiempo, Apolos estaba en la ciudad de Corinto. Pablo viajó por la región montañosa del interior y llegó a la ciudad de Éfeso. Allí encontró a algunos discípulos. \v 2 Les preguntó: «¿{{plural_you:Recibieron|Recibisteis}} el Espíritu Santo cuando {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?».

sw.L: Basi ikawa, Apolo alipokuwa Korintho, Paulo, akiisha kupita katika sehemu za juu, alifika Efeso, akawakuta wanafunzi kadhaa, \v 2 akawaambia, "Je, mlipokea Roho Mtakatifu mlipoamini?"
sw.B: Apolo alipokuwa Korintho, Paulo alipita katika nchi za bara, akashuka mpaka Efeso. Huko aliwakuta wanafunzi kadhaa, \v 2 akawauliza, "Mlipoamini, mlimpokea Roho Mtakatifu?"
sw.R: Wakati huo Apolo alikuwa katika mji wa Korintho. Paulo alisafiri katika nchi ya milimani iliyo bara, akafika mji wa Efeso. Huko aliwakuta wanafunzi kadhaa. \v 2 Akawauliza, "Je, mlimpokea Roho Mtakatifu mlipoamini?"

vi.L: Xảy ra trong khi A-bô-lô ở Cô-rinh-tô, Phao-lô đi qua các miền phía trên mà đến Ê-phê-sô, và gặp mấy môn đồ, \v 2 ông hỏi họ: "Khi tin, anh em có nhận lãnh Thánh Linh không?"
vi.B: Trong khi A-bô-lô ở Cô-rinh-tô, Phao-lô đi qua các miền nội địa và xuống Ê-phê-sô. Tại đó ông gặp mấy môn đồ \v 2 và hỏi họ: "Khi anh em tin, anh em có nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh không?"
vi.R: Lúc ấy A-bô-lô đang ở thành Cô-rinh-tô. Phao-lô đi qua vùng cao nguyên trong nội địa và đến thành Ê-phê-sô. Ông gặp mấy môn đồ ở đó. \v 2 Ông hỏi họ: "Khi tin, anh em có nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh không?"

ko.L: 그런데 [이런] 일이 있었다. 아볼로가 고린도에 있는 동안, 바울은 윗지방을 거쳐 에베소에 와서 어떤 제자들을 만났다. \v 2 그리고 그들에게 말했다. "여러분은 믿을 때에 성령을 받았습니까?"
ko.B: 아볼로가 고린도에 있는 동안, 바울은 내륙 지방을 거쳐 에베소로 내려왔다. 그곳에서 그는 몇몇 제자를 만나서 \v 2 그들에게 물었다. "여러분은 믿게 되었을 때 성령을 받았습니까?"
ko.R: 그때 아볼로는 고린도라는 도시에 있었다. 바울은 높은 내륙 지방을 지나서 에베소라는 도시로 왔다. 그는 그곳에서 몇몇 제자를 만났다. \v 2 바울이 그들에게 물었다. "여러분은 믿을 때에 성령을 받았습니까?"

decisions.choice: the upper regions: the higher inland country east of Ephesus
alternatives: a particular district called the Upper Parts
decisions.reason: Paul had set out through Galatia and Phrygia (18:23). The road from there to Ephesus came down from the high interior of Asia Minor to the coast.

decisions.choice: disciples: people who followed Jesus in some way, but knew only John's baptism
alternatives: full believers in Jesus who had already received the Spirit
disciples of John the Baptist, not of Jesus
decisions.reason: Luke calls the believers in Jesus "disciples" throughout Acts (6:1, 9:1), and Paul asks them about their believing. Yet they had not heard about the Holy Spirit and knew only John's baptism (19:2-3), like Apollos before Priscilla and Aquila taught him (18:25-26). How much they knew of Jesus is not said.

decisions.choice: when you believed: the receiving and the believing at the same time
alternatives: since you believed, at some time after it
decisions.reason: The participle and the main verb both look at a single past event, so Paul asks whether the Spirit came when they believed. The King James Version's "since ye believed" suggests a later, second event; the Greek does not.

decisions.choice: the city of Corinth; the city of Ephesus
decisions.reason: Readable says that the names are cities.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); historic presents kept at Literal
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Acts: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative and suits a public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school. Speech keeps its own tenses. Literal keeps the present where Luke uses one for a past event (19:35 "déclare"). This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: discípulos at every level
decisions.reason: The book-wide Spanish term, as in 18:23 and 20:1: "discípulos" at every level, where the English Readable sometimes says "followers of Jesus" (19:30). Here it keeps the open question of what kind of disciples these were (meaning decision on disciples).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Recibieron|Recibisteis}} and every plural "you"
decisions.reason: Every plural "you" in this chapter, and its verb, is the plural_you setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain); so in the words to the evil spirits (19:13, 19:15) and in the speeches of Demetrius and the town clerk.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi
decisions.reason: "Wanafunzi" at every level, as the project's Swahili term list settles; these were followers of Jesus who knew only John's baptism (meaning decision), and the word leaves that open as the Greek does. The same in 19:9 and 19:30, where the English Readable says "followers of Jesus".

decisions.choice: Paul says "anh em" to the disciples, and they say "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: He speaks to them as fellow disciples, as the meaning decision says they followed Jesus in some way.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Acts 19; the Holy Spirit and the Lord Jesus take the honorific in the narrative; Paul and the disciples speak to each other in 합쇼체
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters (style guide, section 7). Paul meets men he does not know, and they answer a teacher; both sides use the formal polite style.

source.text: οἱ δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἀλλ’ οὐδ’ εἰ πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἔστιν ἠκούσαμεν.

records.literal_gloss: They and to him, But not even if [a] Spirit Holy there is did we hear.

en.L: And they [said] to him, "No, we have not even heard whether there is [a] Holy Spirit."
en.B: They told him, "No. We never even heard whether there is a Holy Spirit."
en.R: They answered, "No. We have never even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."

fr.L: Et eux [lui répondirent] : « Non, nous n’avons même pas entendu dire s’il y a un Esprit Saint. »
fr.B: Ils lui répondirent : « Non. Nous n’avons même jamais entendu dire s’il y a un Esprit Saint. »
fr.R: Ils ont répondu : « Non. Nous n’avons même jamais entendu dire qu’il y a un Esprit Saint. »

es.L: Y ellos [le dijeron]: «Ni siquiera hemos oído si hay [un] Espíritu Santo».
es.B: Ellos le respondieron: «No. Ni siquiera hemos oído si hay un Espíritu Santo».
es.R: Ellos respondieron: «No. Ni siquiera hemos oído que haya un Espíritu Santo».

sw.L: Nao [wakamwambia], "Hapana, hata hatujasikia kama yupo Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Hapana. Hatujawahi hata kusikia kama kuna Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.R: Wakajibu, "Hapana. Hatujawahi hata kusikia kwamba kuna Roho Mtakatifu."

vi.L: Họ [đáp] lại ông: "Chúng tôi cũng chưa hề nghe nói có Thánh Linh."
vi.B: Họ trả lời: "Không, chúng tôi cũng chưa từng nghe nói có Đức Thánh Linh."
vi.R: Họ trả lời: "Không. Chúng tôi còn chưa bao giờ nghe nói có Đức Thánh Linh."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 그에게 [말했다]. "아닙니다. 우리는 성령이 계시다는 것조차 듣지 못했습니다."
ko.B: 그들이 대답했다. "아닙니다. 우리는 성령이 계시다는 말도 들어 보지 못했습니다."
ko.R: 그들이 대답했다. "아닙니다. 우리는 성령이 계시다는 말을 한 번도 들어 본 적이 없습니다."

decisions.choice: whether there is a Holy Spirit: probably, whether the Holy Spirit has come and been given
alternatives: they had never heard of the Spirit at all
decisions.reason: John the Baptist spoke of one who would baptize with the Holy Spirit (Luke 3:16), so his followers would likely have heard of the Spirit. John 7:39 uses a similar short form, "the Spirit was not yet", meaning not yet given. Still, the words can be read plainly.

decisions.choice: but not even: a strong denial
alternatives: a contrast with what Paul said
decisions.reason: The words mean "no, not even": they had not received the Spirit, and had not even heard of such a thing.

decisions.choice: [said]
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the verb of saying to be understood.

decisions.choice: "성령이 계시다는 것" with the honorific "계시다"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as "whether the Holy Spirit has come and been given" (uncertain); Korean keeps the plain words "that there is a Holy Spirit", and gives the Spirit the honorific as everywhere in Acts.

source.text: εἶπέν τε· Εἰς τί οὖν ἐβαπτίσθητε;

records.literal_gloss: He said then, Into what then were you baptized?

en.L: And he said, "Into what then were you baptized?"
en.B: Paul asked, "Then into what were you baptized?"
en.R: So Paul asked, "Then what kind of baptism did you receive?"

fr.L: Et il dit : « Dans quoi donc avez-vous été baptisés ? »
fr.B: Paul demanda : « Alors, de quel baptême avez-vous été baptisés ? »
fr.R: Paul leur a donc demandé : « Quel baptême avez-vous reçu, alors ? »

es.L: Y dijo: «¿En qué, pues, {{plural_you:fueron bautizados|fuisteis bautizados}}?».
es.B: Pablo preguntó: «Entonces, ¿en qué {{plural_you:fueron bautizados|fuisteis bautizados}}?».
es.R: Entonces Pablo les preguntó: «¿Qué bautismo {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, entonces?».

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Basi mlibatizwa kwa [ubatizo] gani?"
sw.B: Paulo akauliza, "Basi mlibatizwa kwa ubatizo upi?"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Paulo akauliza, "Basi mlipokea ubatizo wa namna gani?"

vi.L: Ông nói: "Vậy anh em đã chịu báp-têm vào điều gì?"
vi.B: Phao-lô hỏi: "Thế thì anh em đã chịu báp-têm vào điều gì?"
vi.R: Vì vậy Phao-lô hỏi: "Vậy anh em đã chịu phép báp-têm nào?"

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "그러면 여러분은 무엇으로 세례를 받았습니까?"
ko.B: 바울이 물었다. "그러면 여러분은 무슨 세례를 받았습니까?"
ko.R: 그래서 바울이 물었다. "그러면 여러분은 어떤 세례를 받았습니까?"

decisions.choice: baptized into what: to what or to whom their baptism joined them
decisions.reason: To be baptized "into" a name is to be made over to that person (19:5; 1 Corinthians 1:13, 10:2). Paul asks what their baptism meant.

decisions.choice: Paul
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: what kind of baptism did you receive?
decisions.reason: Readable asks the question in plain words; the meaning note explains the idiom.

decisions.choice: Dans quoi (L); de quel baptême (B)
decisions.reason: "En quoi" would be heard as "in what way". Literal keeps the preposition of movement with "dans", matching "dans le nom" in 19:5; Balanced asks plainly which baptism they received (m1).

decisions.choice: "무엇으로 세례를 받았습니까" (L) for "into what"
decisions.reason: Korean cannot say "baptized into" something; the meaning decision reads it as what the baptism joined them to. Literal says "무엇으로", Balanced and Readable "무슨 세례", "어떤 세례".

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Εἰς τὸ Ἰωάννου βάπτισμα.

records.literal_gloss: They and said, Into the of John baptism.

en.L: And they said, "Into John's baptism."
en.B: "Into John's baptism," they answered.
en.R: They answered, "We received the baptism that John gave."

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Dans le baptême de Jean. »
fr.B: « Du baptême de Jean », répondirent-ils.
fr.R: Ils ont répondu : « Nous avons reçu le baptême que Jean donnait. »

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «En el bautismo de Juan».
es.B: «En el bautismo de Juan», respondieron.
es.R: Ellos respondieron: «Recibimos el bautismo que Juan daba».

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Kwa ubatizo wa Yohana."
sw.B: Wakajibu, "Kwa ubatizo wa Yohana."
sw.R: Wakajibu, "Tulipokea ubatizo ambao Yohana alitoa."

vi.L: Họ nói: "Vào phép báp-têm của Giăng."
vi.B: Họ đáp: "Vào phép báp-têm của Giăng."
vi.R: Họ trả lời: "Chúng tôi đã chịu phép báp-têm của Giăng."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "요한의 세례로 [받았습니다]."
ko.B: 그들이 대답했다. "요한의 세례를 받았습니다."
ko.R: 그들이 대답했다. "우리는 요한이 베푼 세례를 받았습니다."

decisions.choice: John's baptism: the baptism John the Baptist preached, a sign of turning back to God
decisions.reason: Apollos, from Alexandria, also knew only John's baptism (18:25). John's baptism had spread beyond Judea, and these men may have received it from others who had heard John.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ Παῦλος· Ἰωάννης ἐβάπτισεν βάπτισμα μετανοίας, τῷ λαῷ λέγων εἰς τὸν ἐρχόμενον μετ’ αὐτὸν ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: Said then Paul, John baptized a baptism of repentance, to the people saying in the [one] coming after him that they should believe, that is in the Jesus.

en.L: And Paul said, "John baptized [with] a baptism of repentance, telling the people that they should believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus."
en.B: Paul said, "The baptism John performed marked people's repentance, and he told the people to believe in the one who would come after him, namely Jesus."
en.R: Paul said, "John baptized people who were turning away from their sins and back to God. He told them to believe in someone who would come after him. That person is Jesus."

fr.L: Et Paul dit : « Jean a baptisé d’un baptême de repentance, disant au peuple qu’en celui qui venait après lui ils devaient croire, c’est-à-dire en Jésus. »
fr.B: Paul dit : « Le baptême que donnait Jean marquait la repentance du peuple, et il disait aux gens de croire en celui qui viendrait après lui, c’est-à-dire en Jésus. »
fr.R: Paul a dit : « Jean baptisait les gens qui abandonnaient leurs péchés et revenaient vers Dieu. Il leur a dit de croire en quelqu’un qui viendrait après lui. Cette personne, c’est Jésus. »

es.L: Y Pablo dijo: «Juan bautizó [con] un bautismo de arrepentimiento, diciendo al pueblo que creyeran en el que venía después de él, es decir, en Jesús».
es.B: Pablo dijo: «El bautismo que Juan hacía era señal de arrepentimiento, y él le decía al pueblo que creyera en el que vendría después de él, es decir, en Jesús».
es.R: Pablo les dijo: «Juan bautizaba a las personas que dejaban sus pecados y se volvían a Dios. Les decía que creyeran en alguien que vendría después de él. Esa persona es Jesús».

sw.L: Naye Paulo akasema, "Yohana alibatiza ubatizo wa toba, akiwaambia watu wamwamini yule ajaye baada yake, yaani, Yesu."
sw.B: Paulo akasema, "Ubatizo aliotoa Yohana ulikuwa ubatizo wa toba, naye aliwaambia watu wamwamini yule ambaye angekuja baada yake, yaani Yesu."
sw.R: Paulo akasema, "Yohana aliwabatiza watu waliokuwa wakiziacha dhambi zao na kumrudia Mungu. Aliwaambia wamwamini mtu ambaye angekuja baada yake. Mtu huyo ni Yesu."

vi.L: Phao-lô nói: "Giăng đã làm phép báp-têm ăn năn, nói với dân chúng phải tin Đấng đến sau mình, tức là tin Đức Giê-xu."
vi.B: Phao-lô nói: "Phép báp-têm Giăng làm là dấu hiệu người ta ăn năn, và ông bảo dân chúng phải tin Đấng sẽ đến sau ông, tức là Đức Giê-xu."
vi.R: Phao-lô nói: "Giăng làm phép báp-têm cho những người đang từ bỏ tội lỗi và quay về với Đức Chúa Trời. Ông bảo họ phải tin một Đấng sẽ đến sau ông. Đấng ấy là Đức Giê-xu."

ko.L: 그러자 바울이 말했다. "요한은 회개의 세례를 베풀면서, 백성에게 자기 뒤에 오시는 분, 곧 예수를 믿으라고 말했습니다."
ko.B: 바울이 말했다. "요한이 베푼 세례는 회개의 세례였습니다. 그리고 그는 백성에게 자기 뒤에 오실 분, 곧 예수를 믿으라고 말했습니다."
ko.R: 바울이 말했다. "요한은 죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오는 사람들에게 세례를 주었습니다. 그리고 그들에게 자기 뒤에 오실 분을 믿으라고 말했습니다. 그분이 바로 예수이십니다."

decisions.choice: a baptism of repentance: a baptism that showed people were turning from their sins to God
alternatives: a baptism that itself brought about repentance
decisions.reason: Luke 3:3 describes John's preaching in the same words. Repentance is a change of mind and life, turning back to God.

decisions.choice: the one coming after him: put first, for weight
decisions.reason: The Greek puts "in the one coming after him" before "that they should believe". Paul's stress falls on the one John pointed to.

decisions.choice: that is, Jesus: Paul names Jesus as the one John promised
alternatives: Paul adds a new teacher to John's message
decisions.reason: John said one more powerful than he was coming (Luke 3:16). Paul makes the same point in Pisidian Antioch (13:24-25): John's baptism looked forward to Jesus.

decisions.choice: people who were turning away from their sins and back to God
decisions.reason: Readable says what repentance means, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: la repentance (L, B); Readable says what it means
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the New Testament: "la repentance" at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains the word, as the English Readable does (m1).

decisions.choice: qu’en celui qui venait après lui ils devaient croire
alternatives: de croire en celui qui venait après lui
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, which puts the one coming first for weight (m2); French allows it in a subordinate clause.

decisions.choice: "phép báp-têm ăn năn" (L); "dấu hiệu người ta ăn năn" (B); explained at Readable
decisions.reason: A baptism that showed people were turning from their sins (meaning decision), as in Luke 3:3.

decisions.choice: "회개의 세례" (L, B); "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오는 사람들에게 세례를 주었습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Luke 3:3 and Mark 1:4.

source.text: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἐβαπτίσθησαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Having heard then they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

en.L: And having heard [this], they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
en.B: When they heard this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
en.R: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus. Now they belonged to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et ayant entendu [cela], ils furent baptisés dans le nom du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.B: Quand ils entendirent cela, ils furent baptisés dans le nom du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.R: Quand ils ont entendu cela, ils ont été baptisés au nom du Seigneur Jésus. Désormais, ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenaient.

es.L: Y habiendo oído [esto], fueron bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.
es.B: Al oír esto, fueron bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.
es.R: Cuando oyeron esto, fueron bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús. Desde entonces le pertenecían a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Na waliposikia [hayo], walibatizwa kwa jina la Bwana Yesu.
sw.B: Waliposikia hayo, walibatizwa kwa jina la Bwana Yesu.
sw.R: Waliposikia hayo, walibatizwa kwa jina la Bwana Yesu. Sasa walikuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Nghe vậy, họ chịu báp-têm vào danh Chúa Giê-xu.
vi.B: Nghe vậy, họ chịu báp-têm vào danh Chúa Giê-xu.
vi.R: Khi nghe điều ấy, họ chịu báp-têm nhân danh Chúa Giê-xu. Từ nay họ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 [이 말을] 듣고 그들은 주 예수의 이름으로 세례를 받았다.
ko.B: 이 말을 듣고 그들은 주 예수의 이름으로 세례를 받았다.
ko.R: 이 말을 듣고 그들은 주 예수의 이름으로 세례를 받았다. 이제 그들은 주 예수께 속한 사람들이 되었다.

decisions.choice: into the name of the Lord Jesus: made over to him, as his own
alternatives: a set form of words only
decisions.reason: As in 8:16 and 1 Corinthians 1:13, to be baptized into someone's name is to come under that person and belong to him. Compare "in the name of Jesus" in 2:38 and 10:48.

decisions.choice: Luke's words about the twelve men, not the end of Paul's speech
alternatives: still Paul speaking: those who heard John were baptized into Jesus
decisions.reason: Verse 6 goes on to tell how Paul laid his hands on "them", the same men, and nowhere is anyone said to have been baptized into Jesus's name by John. So the baptism here is a new one, given because John's baptism looked forward to Jesus.

decisions.choice: Now they belonged to him.
decisions.reason: Readable says what being baptized into his name meant, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: dans le nom (L, B); au nom (R)
decisions.reason: "Au nom de" is the familiar French, but it says "on behalf of" or "by the authority of". "Dans le nom" keeps the Greek picture of being made over to Jesus (m1) at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the familiar phrase and says what it meant in the sentence that follows.

source.text: καὶ ἐπιθέντος αὐτοῖς τοῦ Παύλου χεῖρας ἦλθε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτούς, ἐλάλουν τε γλώσσαις καὶ ἐπροφήτευον.

records.literal_gloss: And having laid on them the Paul hands came the Spirit the Holy upon them, they were speaking then in tongues and prophesying.

en.L: And when Paul had laid [his] hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they were speaking in tongues and prophesying.
en.B: Then as Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them. They began speaking in tongues and prophesying.
en.R: Paul put his hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them. They began to speak in languages they had never learned, and they spoke messages from God.

fr.L: Et Paul leur ayant imposé les mains, l’Esprit Saint vint sur eux, et ils parlaient en langues et prophétisaient.
fr.B: Puis, comme Paul leur imposait les mains, l’Esprit Saint vint sur eux. Ils se mirent à parler en langues et à prophétiser.
fr.R: Paul a posé les mains sur eux, et l’Esprit Saint est venu sur eux. Ils se sont mis à parler dans des langues qu’ils n’avaient jamais apprises, et ils ont annoncé des messages de Dieu.

es.L: Y habiéndoles impuesto Pablo las manos, vino el Espíritu Santo sobre ellos, y hablaban en lenguas y profetizaban.
es.B: Cuando Pablo les impuso las manos, el Espíritu Santo vino sobre ellos, y comenzaron a hablar en lenguas y a profetizar.
es.R: Pablo puso las manos sobre ellos, y el Espíritu Santo vino sobre ellos. Empezaron a hablar en idiomas que nunca habían aprendido, y a anunciar mensajes de parte de Dios.

sw.L: Na Paulo alipokwisha kuweka mikono juu yao, Roho Mtakatifu alikuja juu yao, nao wakawa wakinena kwa lugha na kutabiri.
sw.B: Kisha Paulo alipoweka mikono yake juu yao, Roho Mtakatifu aliwashukia. Wakaanza kunena kwa lugha na kutabiri.
sw.R: Paulo aliweka mikono yake juu yao, na Roho Mtakatifu akawashukia. Wakaanza kusema kwa lugha ambazo hawakuwahi kujifunza, na wakasema ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu.

vi.L: Và khi Phao-lô đặt tay trên họ, Đức Thánh Linh ngự xuống trên họ, và họ nói các thứ tiếng và nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Khi Phao-lô đặt tay trên họ, Đức Thánh Linh ngự xuống trên họ. Họ bắt đầu nói các thứ tiếng và nói tiên tri.
vi.R: Phao-lô đặt tay trên họ, và Đức Thánh Linh ngự xuống trên họ. Họ bắt đầu nói những thứ tiếng mà họ chưa bao giờ học, và họ nói những sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 바울이 그들에게 손을 얹자, 성령께서 그들에게 내려오셨다. 그리고 그들은 방언을 말하고 예언을 하였다.
ko.B: 바울이 그들에게 손을 얹자 성령께서 그들에게 내려오셨다. 그러자 그들은 방언으로 말하고 예언하기 시작했다.
ko.R: 바울이 그들에게 손을 얹자, 성령께서 그들에게 오셨다. 그들은 배운 적이 없는 언어로 말하기 시작했고, 하나님께서 주시는 말씀을 전했다.

decisions.choice: laying on of hands: a sign of prayer and blessing, here as the Spirit was given
decisions.reason: In Samaria the Spirit came when Peter and John laid their hands on the believers (8:17). Ananias laid hands on Saul for him to be filled with the Spirit (9:17).

decisions.choice: tongues: languages, as at Pentecost and in Cornelius's house
decisions.reason: The word means tongues or languages. At Pentecost the languages were understood by people from many nations (2:4-11); in Cornelius's house (10:46) and here, Luke does not say whether anyone understood them.

decisions.choice: prophesying: speaking a message given by God
decisions.reason: As Joel had said, those who receive the Spirit prophesy (2:17-18).

decisions.choice: speak in languages they had never learned; spoke messages from God
decisions.reason: Readable explains both words, as the meaning notes do.

decisions.choice: imposer les mains (L, B); poser les mains sur eux (R)
alternatives: poser les mains at every level
decisions.reason: "Imposer les mains" is the established French phrase for the gesture of prayer and blessing (m1); Readable uses the everyday verb.

decisions.choice: "방언" (L, B); "배운 적이 없는 언어" (R); "예언하다" (L, B), "하나님께서 주시는 말씀을 전하다" (R)
decisions.reason: "방언" is the established word for speaking in tongues; the meaning decision reads the tongues as languages (uncertain), which Readable says, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἦσαν δὲ οἱ πάντες ἄνδρες ὡσεὶ δώδεκα.

records.literal_gloss: Were then the all men about twelve.

en.L: Now the men were about twelve in all.
en.B: In all, the men numbered about twelve.
en.R: There were about twelve men in the group.

fr.L: Or les hommes étaient en tout environ douze.
fr.B: En tout, ces hommes étaient environ douze.
fr.R: Il y avait environ douze hommes dans le groupe.

es.L: Y eran en total unos doce hombres.
es.B: Eran en total unos doce hombres.
es.R: En el grupo había unos doce hombres.

sw.L: Na wanaume wote walikuwa kama kumi na wawili.
sw.B: Kwa jumla wanaume hao walikuwa kama kumi na wawili.
sw.R: Katika kundi hilo kulikuwa na wanaume kama kumi na wawili.

vi.L: Tất cả có khoảng mười hai người nam.
vi.B: Cả thảy có khoảng mười hai người nam.
vi.R: Nhóm ấy có khoảng mười hai người nam.

ko.L: 그 사람들은 모두 열두 명쯤이었다.
ko.B: 그 사람들은 모두 열두 명쯤 되었다.
ko.R: 그 무리에는 남자가 열두 명쯤 있었다.

decisions.choice: about twelve: a round number
alternatives: exactly twelve, a sign pointing to the Twelve apostles
decisions.reason: Luke uses "about" with numbers often (2:41, 4:4). He gives no hint that the number is a symbol.

decisions.choice: men: adult males
decisions.reason: The word means men; Luke counts the men of the group.

source.text: Εἰσελθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐπαρρησιάζετο ἐπὶ μῆνας τρεῖς διαλεγόμενος καὶ πείθων περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Having entered then into the synagogue he was speaking boldly for months three, reasoning and persuading concerning the kingdom of the God.

en.L: And having entered into the synagogue, he spoke boldly for three months, reasoning and persuading concerning the kingdom of God.
en.B: Paul went into the synagogue, and for three months he spoke there without fear, debating and trying to win people over about the kingdom of God.
en.R: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and spoke there without fear. He discussed the Scriptures with the people and tried to convince them about the kingdom of God, God's rule as king.

fr.L: Et étant entré dans la synagogue, il parlait avec assurance pendant trois mois, discutant et persuadant au sujet du royaume de Dieu.
fr.B: Paul se rendit à la synagogue et, pendant trois mois, il y parla sans crainte, discutant et cherchant à convaincre au sujet du royaume de Dieu.
fr.R: Pendant trois mois, Paul est allé à la synagogue et il y a parlé sans peur. Il discutait des Écritures avec les gens et il essayait de les convaincre au sujet du royaume de Dieu, c’est-à-dire de Dieu qui règne comme roi.

es.L: Y entrando en la sinagoga, habló con valentía durante tres meses, discutiendo y persuadiendo acerca del reino de Dios.
es.B: Pablo entró en la sinagoga, y durante tres meses habló allí sin temor, debatiendo y tratando de convencer a la gente acerca del reino de Dios.
es.R: Durante tres meses, Pablo fue a la sinagoga y habló allí sin miedo. Conversaba con la gente sobre las Escrituras y trataba de convencerlos acerca del reino de Dios, es decir, de cómo Dios reina como rey.

sw.L: Na akiisha kuingia katika sinagogi, alinena kwa ujasiri kwa miezi mitatu, akihojiana na kuwashawishi kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu.
sw.B: Paulo aliingia katika sinagogi, na kwa miezi mitatu alinena humo bila hofu, akijadiliana na watu na kujaribu kuwavuta kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu.
sw.R: Kwa miezi mitatu Paulo alikwenda katika sinagogi, akahubiri humo bila hofu. Alijadiliana na watu kuhusu Maandiko, akajaribu kuwashawishi kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu, yaani Mungu kutawala kama Mfalme.

vi.L: Ông vào nhà hội, và trong ba tháng ông mạnh dạn giảng, biện luận và thuyết phục về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Phao-lô vào nhà hội, và trong ba tháng ông mạnh dạn giảng dạy ở đó, biện luận và thuyết phục người ta về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Trong ba tháng, Phao-lô đến nhà hội và mạnh dạn giảng ở đó. Ông bàn luận về Kinh Thánh với mọi người và cố gắng thuyết phục họ về vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời, tức là sự cai trị của Đức Chúa Trời với tư cách là Vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 회당에 들어가서 석 달 동안 담대하게 말하며, 하나님의 나라에 관해 토론하고 설득하였다.
ko.B: 바울은 회당에 들어가서 석 달 동안 두려움 없이 말했다. 그는 하나님의 나라에 관해 토론하며 사람들을 설득하려고 했다.
ko.R: 바울은 석 달 동안 회당에 가서 두려워하지 않고 말씀을 전했다. 그는 그곳 사람들과 성경을 놓고 이야기를 나누며, 하나님의 나라, 곧 하나님께서 왕으로 다스리시는 일에 관해 그들을 설득하려고 했다.

decisions.choice: the synagogue: the Jewish meeting place in Ephesus, where Paul had promised to return
decisions.reason: On his first short visit Paul reasoned in this synagogue, and its people asked him to stay longer; he left promising to come back if God willed (18:19-21).

decisions.choice: reasoning: discussing and arguing, from the Scriptures
alternatives: giving a lecture with no exchange
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of Paul in Thessalonica, where he reasoned from the Scriptures (17:2), and in Corinth (18:4). It means talking things through with others.

decisions.choice: persuading: trying to persuade
decisions.reason: The present participle describes an effort that went on. Verse 9 shows that not everyone was persuaded.

decisions.choice: the kingdom of God: God's rule, which comes through Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus spoke of the kingdom of God after he rose (1:3), and Acts ends with Paul proclaiming it (28:23, 28:31). It sums up the message about Jesus.

decisions.choice: discussed the Scriptures; God's rule as king
decisions.reason: Readable says what Paul discussed and what the kingdom of God means, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: la synagogue; le royaume de Dieu at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the New Testament and Acts 1:3. Readable keeps "le royaume" and says what it means, as the English Readable does (m4).

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" at every level, explained at Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Luke 4:43.

source.text: ὡς δέ τινες ἐσκληρύνοντο καὶ ἠπείθουν κακολογοῦντες τὴν ὁδὸν ἐνώπιον τοῦ πλήθους, ἀποστὰς ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀφώρισεν τοὺς μαθητάς, καθ’ ἡμέραν διαλεγόμενος ἐν τῇ σχολῇ Τυράννου.

records.literal_gloss: When however some were hardened and were disobeying, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, having departed from them he took separately the disciples, every day reasoning in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.

en.L: But when some were being hardened and were disobeying, speaking evil of the Way before the crowd, he withdrew from them and took the disciples apart, reasoning daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
en.B: Some, though, hardened themselves and refused to be persuaded, and they spoke against the Way in front of the gathering. Paul then withdrew from them, taking the disciples apart with him, and each day he held discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
en.R: But some of the Jews there became stubborn. They refused to accept the message, and in front of everyone they said bad things about the Way, which is what the movement of Jesus's followers was called. So Paul stopped going to the synagogue. He took the disciples with him, and every day he taught and talked with people in the lecture hall of a man named Tyrannus.

fr.L: Mais comme certains s’endurcissaient et désobéissaient, disant du mal de la Voie devant la multitude, s’étant éloigné d’eux, il sépara les disciples, discutant chaque jour dans la salle d’enseignement de Tyrannus.
fr.B: Mais certains s’endurcirent et refusèrent de se laisser convaincre ; devant la foule, ils disaient du mal de la Voie. Paul se retira alors de chez eux, emmena les disciples à part, et chaque jour il tint des discussions dans la salle d’enseignement de Tyrannus.
fr.R: Mais quelques Juifs de la synagogue sont devenus têtus. Ils ont refusé d’accepter le message, et devant tout le monde, ils disaient du mal de la Voie. C’est ainsi qu’on appelait le mouvement de ceux qui suivaient Jésus. Alors Paul a cessé d’aller à la synagogue. Il a emmené les disciples avec lui, et chaque jour, il enseignait et discutait avec les gens dans la salle d’enseignement d’un homme appelé Tyrannus.

es.L: Pero como algunos se endurecían y no creían, hablando mal del Camino delante de la multitud, se apartó de ellos y separó a los discípulos, discutiendo cada día en la escuela de Tirano.
es.B: Pero algunos se endurecieron y se negaron a dejarse convencer, y hablaban mal del Camino delante de la gente. Entonces Pablo se apartó de ellos, se llevó aparte a los discípulos y cada día debatía en la sala de conferencias de Tirano.
es.R: Pero algunos de los judíos de allí se pusieron tercos. No quisieron aceptar el mensaje, y delante de todos hablaban mal del Camino, el nombre que se daba al grupo de los discípulos de Jesús. Por eso Pablo dejó de ir a la sinagoga. Se llevó a los discípulos con él, y cada día enseñaba y conversaba con la gente en la sala de conferencias de un hombre llamado Tirano.

sw.L: Lakini wengine walipokuwa wakijifanya wagumu na kukataa kutii, wakiitukana Njia mbele ya umati, alijitenga nao, akawatenga wanafunzi, akihojiana kila siku katika ukumbi wa mafundisho wa Tirano.
sw.B: Lakini baadhi yao walifanya mioyo yao kuwa migumu, wakakataa kushawishika, wakaisema Njia vibaya mbele ya kusanyiko. Basi Paulo aliwaacha, akawachukua wanafunzi pamoja naye, na kila siku akajadiliana na watu katika ukumbi wa mafundisho wa Tirano.
sw.R: Lakini baadhi ya Wayahudi wa huko walikuwa wakaidi. Walikataa kuukubali ujumbe, na mbele ya watu wote walisema mabaya kuhusu Njia, yaani jina walilopewa wafuasi wa Yesu. Kwa hiyo Paulo aliacha kwenda sinagogini. Aliwachukua wanafunzi pamoja naye, na kila siku alifundisha na kuzungumza na watu katika ukumbi wa mafundisho wa mtu mmoja aitwaye Tirano.

vi.L: Nhưng khi có mấy người cứng lòng và không tin, nói xấu Đạo trước mặt dân chúng, ông bỏ họ mà đi, tách riêng các môn đồ ra, hằng ngày biện luận trong giảng đường của Ti-ra-nu.
vi.B: Nhưng có mấy người cứng lòng, không chịu tin, và nói xấu Đạo trước mặt hội chúng. Vì vậy Phao-lô rời họ, đem các môn đồ đi riêng, và mỗi ngày ông thảo luận tại giảng đường của Ti-ra-nu.
vi.R: Nhưng một số người Do Thái ở đó trở nên cứng lòng. Họ không chịu nhận sứ điệp, và trước mặt mọi người, họ nói xấu Đạo, là tên gọi phong trào của những người theo Đức Giê-xu. Vì vậy Phao-lô thôi không đến nhà hội nữa. Ông đem các môn đồ đi với mình, và mỗi ngày ông dạy dỗ và trò chuyện với mọi người tại giảng đường của một người tên là Ti-ra-nu.

ko.L: 그러나 어떤 사람들이 마음이 굳어져 순종하지 않고, 무리 앞에서 그 길을 비방하자, 그는 그들을 떠나 제자들을 따로 세우고, 날마다 두란노 강당에서 토론하였다.
ko.B: 그러나 어떤 사람들은 마음을 굳게 하고 믿기를 거부하며, 모인 사람들 앞에서 그 길을 비방했다. 그러자 바울은 그들을 떠나 제자들을 따로 데리고 나가서, 날마다 두란노 강당에서 토론했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그곳 유대인들 가운데 몇 사람은 고집을 부렸다. 그들은 그 말씀을 받아들이지 않았고, 모든 사람 앞에서 그 길을 나쁘게 말했다. 그 길은 예수를 따르는 사람들의 무리를 부르는 이름이었다. 그래서 바울은 더 이상 회당에 가지 않았다. 그는 제자들을 데리고 두란노라는 사람의 강당으로 가서, 날마다 그곳에서 사람들을 가르치고 이야기를 나누었다.

decisions.choice: were hardened and disobeying: they set themselves against the message and refused it
alternatives: God hardened them against their will
decisions.reason: The first verb describes a growing stubbornness. The second means to refuse to be persuaded, and so to disobey; it is used of the Jews in Iconium who refused the message (14:2).

decisions.choice: the Way: the name for the movement of Jesus's followers
alternatives: a way of life in general
decisions.reason: Acts uses "the Way" as a name for the believers and their teaching (9:2, 19:23, 22:4, 24:14, 24:22). Apollos had been taught "the way of the Lord" (18:25-26).

decisions.choice: took the disciples apart: led the believers away from the synagogue to meet on their own
decisions.reason: The verb means to set apart. Paul withdrew, and the disciples went with him, as in Corinth (18:7).

decisions.choice: the lecture hall of Tyrannus: a hall used for teaching, known by the name of its owner or of a teacher who taught there
alternatives: a school Tyrannus ran for Paul
decisions.reason: The word first meant leisure, then a place where lectures were given. Nothing more is known of Tyrannus.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus"
alternatives: some manuscripts add "from the fifth hour to the tenth"
decisions.reason: Codex Bezae and some other Western witnesses add that Paul taught "from the fifth hour to the tenth", that is, from about eleven in the morning to four in the afternoon, the hot part of the day when the hall would be free. The addition is not in the main early manuscripts. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: some of the Jews there; which is what the movement of Jesus's followers was called
decisions.reason: Readable says who "some" were (the people of the synagogue, 19:8) and what "the Way" was, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: stopped going to the synagogue
decisions.reason: Readable says what withdrawing from them meant.

decisions.choice: la Voie, with a capital
decisions.reason: The name of the movement (m2), capitalised as a name so that it is not read as an ordinary road or method; "la Voie" is the usual French name.

decisions.choice: la salle d’enseignement de Tyrannus
decisions.reason: "École" suggests a school with enrolled pupils; the Greek means a hall used for lectures and teaching (m4).

decisions.choice: la escuela (L); la sala de conferencias (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "escuela", the Greek word's later sense; Balanced and Readable name the place as a hall used for teaching (meaning decision on the lecture hall of Tyrannus), since "escuela" would suggest a school for children.

decisions.choice: Njia, capitalised
decisions.reason: The name for the movement of Jesus's followers (meaning decision), so it is written as a name; the same in 19:23.

decisions.choice: "Đạo" for the Way, as at 9:2 (also 19:23; 22:4; 24:14, 22)
decisions.reason: The name of the movement (meaning decision), with the book-wide word.

decisions.choice: "giảng đường của Ti-ra-nu"
decisions.reason: A hall used for teaching (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "그 길" at every level for "the Way", with a sentence at Readable saying it was the name of the movement of Jesus's followers
decisions.reason: As set at 18:25 and in the Korean of Acts 9:2: the plain word "길" keeps the Greek name, and Readable explains it here, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "두란노 강당" (L, B); "두란노라는 사람의 강당" (R)
decisions.reason: "강당" is a hall for lectures (meaning decision); "서원" is a Korean school for Confucian learning. "두란노" is the Protestant form of Tyrannus.

source.text: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ ἔτη δύο, ὥστε πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν Ἀσίαν ἀκοῦσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου, Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας.

records.literal_gloss: This then continued for years two, so that all those inhabiting the Asia heard the word of the Lord, Jews both and Greeks.

en.L: And this continued for two years, so that all who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.
en.B: This carried on for two years, with the result that all the people of the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
en.R: Paul kept doing this for two years. Because of this, all the people who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord. Jews heard it, and Greeks heard it too.

fr.L: Et cela dura deux ans, de sorte que tous ceux qui habitaient l’Asie entendirent la parole du Seigneur, Juifs et Grecs.
fr.B: Cela continua pendant deux ans, si bien que tous les habitants de la province d’Asie, Juifs comme Grecs, entendirent la parole du Seigneur.
fr.R: Paul a continué ainsi pendant deux ans. Grâce à cela, tous les gens qui vivaient dans la province d’Asie ont entendu la parole du Seigneur. Les Juifs l’ont entendue, et les Grecs aussi.

es.L: Y esto continuó durante dos años, de modo que todos los que habitaban en Asia oyeron la palabra del Señor, tanto judíos como griegos.
es.B: Esto siguió así durante dos años, de modo que todos los habitantes de la provincia de Asia, judíos y griegos por igual, oyeron la palabra del Señor.
es.R: Pablo siguió haciendo esto durante dos años. Por eso todas las personas que vivían en la provincia de Asia oyeron la palabra del Señor. La oyeron los judíos, y también los griegos.

sw.L: Na hili liliendelea kwa miaka miwili, hata wote waliokaa Asia wakalisikia neno la Bwana, Wayahudi na Wagiriki.
sw.B: Jambo hili liliendelea kwa miaka miwili, hata watu wote wa jimbo la Asia, Wayahudi na Wagiriki pia, wakalisikia neno la Bwana.
sw.R: Paulo aliendelea kufanya hivyo kwa miaka miwili. Kwa sababu hiyo, watu wote walioishi katika jimbo la Asia walilisikia neno la Bwana. Wayahudi walilisikia, na Wagiriki pia.

vi.L: Việc ấy kéo dài hai năm, đến nỗi mọi người sống ở A-si, cả người Do Thái lẫn người Hy Lạp, đều nghe lời Chúa.
vi.B: Việc này tiếp tục trong hai năm, nên mọi người ở tỉnh A-si, cả người Do Thái lẫn người Hy Lạp, đều được nghe lời Chúa.
vi.R: Phao-lô cứ làm như vậy trong hai năm. Nhờ đó, mọi người sống ở tỉnh A-si đều được nghe lời Chúa. Người Do Thái nghe, và người Hy Lạp cũng nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일이 두 해 동안 계속되었다. 그래서 아시아에 사는 모든 사람이, 유대인이나 그리스 사람이나, 주님의 말씀을 들었다.
ko.B: 이 일이 두 해 동안 계속되었다. 그래서 아시아 지방에 사는 사람은 유대인이든 그리스 사람이든 모두 주님의 말씀을 들었다.
ko.R: 바울은 두 해 동안 이렇게 했다. 그래서 아시아 지방에 사는 모든 사람이 주님의 말씀을 들었다. 유대인들도 들었고, 그리스 사람들도 들었다.

decisions.choice: Asia: the Roman province in the west of Asia Minor, with Ephesus as its leading city
decisions.reason: Asia in the New Testament is the Roman province. Ephesus was its greatest city and the seat of its governor.

decisions.choice: all who lived in Asia heard: a sweeping way of saying the message reached the whole province
decisions.reason: Others carried the message out from Ephesus. Churches at Colossae, Laodicea and Hierapolis knew Paul's fellow worker Epaphras rather than Paul himself (Colossians 1:7, 2:1, 4:13).

decisions.choice: Greeks: non-Jews, people of Greek speech and culture
decisions.reason: Set beside "Jews", the word stands for the Gentiles of the province (compare 14:1, 18:4).

decisions.choice: the province of Asia
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that Asia is a province, not the continent.

source.text: Δυνάμεις τε οὐ τὰς τυχούσας ὁ θεὸς ἐποίει διὰ τῶν χειρῶν Παύλου, ὥστε καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀσθενοῦντας ἀποφέρεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ σουδάρια ἢ σιμικίνθια καὶ ἀπαλλάσσεσθαι ἀπ’ αὐτῶν τὰς νόσους, τά τε πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ ἐκπορεύεσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: Miracles then not the ordinary the God was doing through the hands of Paul, \v 12 so that even to the ailing were carried away from the skin of him handkerchiefs or aprons and departed from them the diseases, the and spirits the evil went out.

en.L: And God was doing not-ordinary miracles through the hands of Paul, \v 12 so that even handkerchiefs or aprons [that had touched] his skin were carried away to the sick, and the diseases left them, and the evil spirits went out.
en.B: God worked miracles of no common kind through Paul's hands, \v 12 so that people would even take cloths and work aprons that had touched his skin to those who were ill. Their sicknesses left them, and the evil spirits came out.
en.R: God used Paul to do miracles that were very unusual. \v 12 People even took small cloths and aprons that had touched Paul's skin, and they carried them to sick people. Then the sicknesses left them, and evil spirits came out of them.

fr.L: Et Dieu faisait des miracles non ordinaires par les mains de Paul, \v 12 au point que même des mouchoirs ou des tabliers [ayant touché] sa peau étaient emportés vers les malades, et les maladies les quittaient, et les esprits mauvais sortaient.
fr.B: Dieu accomplissait par les mains de Paul des miracles hors du commun, \v 12 si bien qu’on allait jusqu’à porter aux malades des linges et des tabliers de travail qui avaient touché sa peau. Leurs maladies les quittaient, et les esprits mauvais sortaient.
fr.R: Dieu s’est servi de Paul pour faire des miracles très étonnants. \v 12 Les gens prenaient même de petits morceaux de tissu et des tabliers qui avaient touché la peau de Paul, et ils les apportaient aux malades. Alors les maladies quittaient ces malades, et les esprits mauvais sortaient d’eux.

es.L: Y Dios hacía milagros no comunes por las manos de Pablo, \v 12 de modo que incluso se llevaban a los enfermos pañuelos o delantales [que habían tocado] su piel, y las enfermedades se iban de ellos, y los espíritus malignos salían.
es.B: Dios hacía milagros extraordinarios por medio de las manos de Pablo, \v 12 hasta el punto de que la gente llevaba a los enfermos pañuelos y delantales de trabajo que habían tocado su piel. Las enfermedades los dejaban, y los espíritus malignos salían.
es.R: Dios usaba a Pablo para hacer milagros muy poco comunes. \v 12 La gente incluso tomaba pañuelos y delantales que habían tocado la piel de Pablo, y los llevaba a los enfermos. Entonces las enfermedades los dejaban, y los espíritus malignos salían de ellos.

sw.L: Na Mungu alikuwa akifanya miujiza isiyo ya kawaida kupitia mikono ya Paulo, \v 12 hata leso au aproni [zilizogusa] ngozi yake zilipelekwa kwa wagonjwa, na magonjwa yakawaacha, na pepo wabaya wakawatoka.
sw.B: Mungu alifanya miujiza isiyo ya kawaida kupitia mikono ya Paulo, \v 12 hata watu walichukua vitambaa na aproni za kazi zilizogusa ngozi yake, wakawapelekea wagonjwa. Magonjwa yao yakawaacha, na pepo wabaya wakawatoka.
sw.R: Mungu alimtumia Paulo kufanya miujiza ya ajabu sana. \v 12 Watu walichukua hata vitambaa vidogo na aproni zilizogusa ngozi ya Paulo, wakawapelekea wagonjwa. Ndipo magonjwa yakawaacha, na pepo wabaya wakawatoka.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời làm những phép lạ phi thường qua tay Phao-lô, \v 12 đến nỗi người ta lấy khăn tay hay tạp dề đã chạm vào da ông mà đem đến cho những người bệnh, thì bệnh tật lìa khỏi họ, và các tà linh đi ra.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời dùng tay Phao-lô làm những phép lạ khác thường, \v 12 đến nỗi người ta còn lấy khăn tay và tạp dề đã chạm vào da ông đem đến cho người bệnh. Bệnh tật lìa khỏi họ, và các tà linh đi ra.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời dùng Phao-lô để làm những phép lạ rất khác thường. \v 12 Người ta còn lấy những khăn nhỏ và tạp dề đã chạm vào da Phao-lô, rồi đem đến cho người bệnh. Bấy giờ bệnh tật lìa khỏi họ, và các tà linh ra khỏi họ.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서는 바울의 손을 통해 예사롭지 않은 능력 있는 일들을 행하셨다. \v 12 그래서 사람들이 그의 살갗에 [닿았던] 손수건이나 앞치마를 병든 사람들에게 가져가기까지 하였는데, 그러면 병이 그들에게서 떠나고 악한 영들이 나갔다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 바울의 손을 통해 보통이 아닌 기적들을 행하셨다. \v 12 사람들은 바울의 몸에 닿았던 손수건이나 앞치마를 가져다가 아픈 사람들에게 얹기까지 했다. 그러면 병이 그들에게서 떠나고, 악한 영들이 나갔다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 바울을 통해 아주 놀라운 기적들을 행하셨다. \v 12 사람들은 바울의 몸에 닿았던 작은 천이나 앞치마를 아픈 사람들에게 가져가기까지 했다. 그러면 병이 나았고, 악한 영들이 그 사람들에게서 나갔다.

decisions.choice: not ordinary: unusual, extraordinary
decisions.reason: "Not the ones that happen by chance" is a way of saying "remarkable", with the stress on how unusual they were (compare 28:2).

decisions.choice: God did the miracles, through Paul
alternatives: the power belonged to Paul or to the cloths
decisions.reason: God is the subject of the verb. The story that follows (19:13-19) sets this beside magic, in which people tried to use a name as a spell.

decisions.choice: handkerchiefs and aprons: cloths for wiping sweat, and the aprons of a working man
decisions.reason: Both are Latin words taken into Greek. The first is a cloth for the face or for wrapping (Luke 19:20, John 11:44). The second is an apron or half-belt worn at work, fitting for Paul, who worked with his hands in Ephesus (20:34; compare 18:3). Exactly which cloths are meant is not certain.

decisions.choice: the diseases and the evil spirits: both healing and freeing from spirits
decisions.reason: Luke, like the Gospels, tells of sickness and of evil spirits as two kinds of trouble (Luke 6:18, 7:21).

decisions.choice: that had touched his skin
decisions.reason: "From his skin" means cloths that had been on his body; every level supplies the verb, Literal in brackets.

decisions.choice: los espíritus malignos
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering for "evil spirits", at every level and through 19:13-16; "espíritu impuro" is kept for the Greek "unclean spirit".

decisions.choice: pepo wabaya
decisions.reason: The evil spirits are "pepo wabaya" at every level, as the project's Swahili term list has it, since "roho" is kept for the Holy Spirit and the human spirit; the same through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "các tà linh" for the evil spirits
decisions.reason: The plain word for evil spirits, as in 16:16-18.

decisions.choice: "능력 있는 일들" (L), "기적들" (B, R) for dynameis; "악한 영들" at every level for the evil spirits, through Acts 19
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Luke: "능력 있는 일" keeps the root of the Greek word at Literal; "악한 영" is the Korean Luke's word for "evil spirits" (Luke 7:21; 8:2).

source.text: ἐπεχείρησαν δέ τινες καὶ τῶν περιερχομένων Ἰουδαίων ἐξορκιστῶν ὀνομάζειν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔχοντας τὰ πνεύματα τὰ πονηρὰ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες· Ὁρκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν Παῦλος κηρύσσει.

records.literal_gloss: Attempted now some also of the itinerant Jews exorcists to name over those having the spirits the evil the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, I adjure you [by] the Jesus whom Paul proclaims.

en.L: Now some of the itinerant Jewish exorcists also attempted to name the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had the evil spirits, saying, "I adjure you by the Jesus whom Paul proclaims."
en.B: There were also some Jewish exorcists who traveled from town to town, and they tried calling on the name of the Lord Jesus over people who had evil spirits. "I charge you by the Jesus whom Paul preaches," they would say.
en.R: Some Jews traveled from town to town and tried to force evil spirits out of people. Some of these men also tried to use the name of the Lord Jesus to do it. They said to the evil spirits, "By the power of Jesus, the one Paul preaches about, I order you to come out!"

fr.L: Or quelques-uns aussi des exorcistes juifs itinérants entreprirent de prononcer le nom du Seigneur Jésus sur ceux qui avaient les esprits mauvais, en disant : « Je vous adjure par le Jésus que Paul proclame. »
fr.B: Il y avait aussi des exorcistes juifs qui allaient de ville en ville, et ils essayèrent d’invoquer le nom du Seigneur Jésus sur des gens qui avaient des esprits mauvais. « Je vous conjure par ce Jésus que Paul prêche », disaient-ils.
fr.R: Des Juifs allaient de ville en ville et essayaient de chasser les esprits mauvais hors des gens. Certains d’entre eux ont aussi essayé d’utiliser le nom du Seigneur Jésus pour le faire. Ils disaient aux esprits mauvais : « Par la puissance de Jésus, celui que Paul annonce, je vous ordonne de sortir ! »

es.L: Y también algunos de los exorcistas judíos ambulantes intentaron invocar el nombre del Señor Jesús sobre los que tenían los espíritus malignos, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Los|Os}} conjuro por el Jesús que Pablo predica».
es.B: Había también algunos exorcistas judíos que andaban de pueblo en pueblo, y trataron de invocar el nombre del Señor Jesús sobre los que tenían espíritus malignos. Decían: «{{plural_you:Los|Os}} conjuro por Jesús, a quien Pablo predica».
es.R: Algunos judíos iban de pueblo en pueblo tratando de echar los espíritus malignos fuera de las personas. Algunos de estos hombres también trataron de usar el nombre del Señor Jesús para hacerlo. Les decían a los espíritus malignos: «¡Por el poder de Jesús, el que Pablo anuncia, {{plural_you:les|os}} ordeno que {{plural_you:salgan|salgáis}}!».

sw.L: Basi baadhi ya Wayahudi watoa pepo waliokuwa wakizunguka-zunguka walijaribu pia kulitaja jina la Bwana Yesu juu ya wale waliokuwa na pepo wabaya, wakisema, "Nawaapisha kwa Yesu yule ambaye Paulo anamhubiri."
sw.B: Kulikuwa pia na Wayahudi fulani watoa pepo waliosafiri kutoka mji hadi mji, nao walijaribu kulitaja jina la Bwana Yesu juu ya watu waliokuwa na pepo wabaya. Walikuwa wakisema, "Nawaamuru kwa jina la Yesu yule ambaye Paulo anamhubiri."
sw.R: Kulikuwa na Wayahudi fulani waliosafiri kutoka mji hadi mji wakijaribu kuwatoa watu pepo wabaya kwa nguvu. Baadhi yao walijaribu pia kulitumia jina la Bwana Yesu kufanya hivyo. Waliwaambia wale pepo wabaya, "Kwa uweza wa Yesu, yule ambaye Paulo anamhubiri, nawaamuru mtoke!"

vi.L: Cũng có mấy người Do Thái đi khắp nơi trừ quỷ, thử lấy danh Chúa Giê-xu mà gọi trên những người bị tà linh ám, nói: "Ta nhân danh Giê-xu mà Phao-lô rao giảng, truyền cho các ngươi."
vi.B: Cũng có mấy thầy trừ quỷ người Do Thái đi từ thành này sang thành khác, thử dùng danh Chúa Giê-xu mà gọi trên những người bị tà linh ám. Họ nói: "Ta nhân danh Giê-xu mà Phao-lô rao giảng, ra lệnh cho các ngươi!"
vi.R: Có mấy người Do Thái đi từ thành này sang thành khác để đuổi tà linh ra khỏi người ta. Một số người trong họ cũng thử dùng danh Chúa Giê-xu để làm việc ấy. Họ nói với các tà linh: "Bởi quyền năng của Giê-xu, người mà Phao-lô rao giảng, ta ra lệnh cho các ngươi phải ra!"

ko.L: 그런데 돌아다니는 유대인 퇴마사들 가운데 몇 사람도, 악한 영들이 들린 사람들에게 주 예수의 이름을 불러 보려고 하면서 말했다. "바울이 전파하는 예수를 힘입어 내가 너희에게 명령한다."
ko.B: 그런데 여기저기 돌아다니며 귀신을 쫓아내는 유대인들 가운데 몇 사람도, 악한 영이 들린 사람들에게 주 예수의 이름을 불러 보려고 했다. 그들은 "바울이 전하는 예수의 이름으로 너희에게 명령한다" 하고 말하곤 했다.
ko.R: 이 마을 저 마을을 다니면서 사람들에게서 악한 영들을 쫓아내려고 하는 유대인들이 있었다. 그들 가운데 몇 사람도 주 예수의 이름을 써서 그 일을 해 보려고 했다. 그들은 악한 영들에게 말했다. "바울이 전하는 예수의 능력으로 너희에게 명령한다. 나오너라!"

decisions.choice: itinerant exorcists: people who went from place to place driving out spirits with spells and oaths
decisions.reason: Such exorcists were known among Jews and others. Josephus tells of a Jew named Eleazar who drove out demons with spells said to come from Solomon (Antiquities 8.46-48).

decisions.choice: to name the name over them: to use Jesus's name as a spell, without faith in him
decisions.reason: They speak of "the Jesus whom Paul proclaims", not of their own Lord. Luke shows that the name is not a magic word (compare 3:16, 8:18-24).

decisions.choice: I adjure you: I put you under oath, I command you by a higher power
decisions.reason: The verb means to bind someone by an oath. The man with a legion of spirits uses it to Jesus (Mark 5:7).

decisions.choice: I order you to come out!
decisions.reason: Readable says what the exorcists commanded; the meaning note explains the verb.

decisions.choice: Je vous adjure (L); Je vous conjure (B)
decisions.reason: Both French verbs mean to command under oath by a higher power (m3). "Adjurer" is the closer, more technical word; "conjurer" is better known and keeps the sense of a solemn charge.

decisions.choice: conjuro
decisions.reason: The verb puts someone under oath by a higher power (meaning decision on "I adjure you"); Spanish "conjurar" is the word for calling on such a power against spirits. Readable says plainly "les ordeno que salgan", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Nawaapisha (L); Nawaamuru kwa jina la (B)
decisions.reason: The verb puts the spirits under oath by a higher power (meaning decision): Literal keeps "kuapisha" (to put under oath), and Balanced says "I command you by" as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ta ... các ngươi" in the exorcists' formula, and "Giê-xu" with no "Đức"
decisions.reason: They use the name as a spell, without faith in him (meaning decision), so they do not give him the honorific; the narrator says "Chúa Giê-xu".

decisions.choice: "퇴마사들" (L); "귀신을 쫓아내는 사람들" (B, R) for the exorcists; they speak to the spirits in 해라체 and of Jesus with no honorific ("예수")
decisions.reason: The exorcists use the name as a spell, without faith in Jesus (meaning decision), so they do not honour him. "퇴마사" is the current word for one who drives out spirits by spells; Balanced and Readable say what they did.

source.text: ἦσαν δέ τινος Σκευᾶ Ἰουδαίου ἀρχιερέως ἑπτὰ υἱοὶ τοῦτο ποιοῦντες.

records.literal_gloss: Were now of a certain Sceva, a Jew, a high priest, seven sons this doing.

en.L: Now seven sons of a certain Sceva, a Jewish high priest, were doing this.
en.B: A Jewish high priest named Sceva had seven sons who were doing this.
en.R: Seven sons of a man named Sceva were doing this. Sceva was a Jew who was called a high priest.

fr.L: Or c’étaient sept fils d’un certain Scéva, grand prêtre juif, qui faisaient cela.
fr.B: Un grand prêtre juif nommé Scéva avait sept fils qui faisaient cela.
fr.R: Sept fils d’un homme appelé Scéva faisaient cela. Scéva était un Juif qui portait le titre de grand prêtre.

es.L: Y había siete hijos de un tal Esceva, judío, sumo sacerdote, que hacían esto.
es.B: Un sumo sacerdote judío llamado Esceva tenía siete hijos que hacían esto.
es.R: Siete hijos de un hombre llamado Esceva estaban haciendo esto. Esceva era un judío al que llamaban sumo sacerdote.

sw.L: Na wana saba wa mtu mmoja Skewa, kuhani mkuu Myahudi, walikuwa wakifanya hivyo.
sw.B: Kuhani mkuu mmoja Myahudi aitwaye Skewa alikuwa na wana saba waliokuwa wakifanya hivyo.
sw.R: Wana saba wa mtu mmoja aitwaye Skewa walikuwa wakifanya hivyo. Skewa alikuwa Myahudi aliyeitwa kuhani mkuu.

vi.L: Có bảy người con trai của một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Do Thái tên là Sê-va làm việc này.
vi.B: Có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Do Thái tên là Sê-va có bảy người con trai làm việc này.
vi.R: Bảy người con trai của một người tên là Sê-va đã làm việc này. Sê-va là một người Do Thái được gọi là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm.

ko.L: 그런데 스게와라는 어떤 유대인 대제사장의 아들 일곱이 이 일을 하고 있었다.
ko.B: 유대인 대제사장 스게와라는 사람의 일곱 아들이 이런 일을 하고 있었다.
ko.R: 스게와라는 사람의 일곱 아들이 이런 일을 하고 있었다. 스게와는 유대인으로, 대제사장이라고 불리는 사람이었다.

decisions.choice: a Jewish high priest: no high priest named Sceva is known
alternatives: a member of one of the chief-priestly families
a title Sceva or his sons claimed for themselves
decisions.reason: Josephus names the high priests of this period, and Sceva is not among them. In Acts the plural of the word also means the chief priests, the leading priestly families (4:23, 5:24), so Sceva may have belonged to such a family. Or he may have called himself a high priest to impress people who sought exorcists. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: a Jew who was called a high priest
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the title as Luke reports it without saying it was an office he held in Jerusalem, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: grand prêtre, without a hyphen
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the New Testament; the title keeps the same form wherever it occurs.

source.text: ἀποκριθὲν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τὸν Ἰησοῦν γινώσκω καὶ τὸν Παῦλον ἐπίσταμαι, ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνες ἐστέ;

records.literal_gloss: Answering however the spirit the evil said to them, The Jesus I know and the Paul I am acquainted with, you however who are you?

en.L: But the evil spirit answered and said to them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I am acquainted with, but you, who are you?"
en.B: The evil spirit answered them, "I know Jesus, and I am acquainted with Paul. But you, who are you?"
en.R: But the evil spirit said to them, "I know who Jesus is, and I know about Paul. But who are you?"

fr.L: Mais l’esprit mauvais, répondant, leur dit : « Jésus, je le connais, et Paul, je sais [qui il est] ; mais vous, qui êtes-vous ? »
fr.B: L’esprit mauvais leur répondit : « Je connais Jésus, et je sais qui est Paul. Mais vous, qui êtes-vous ? »
fr.R: Mais l’esprit mauvais leur a dit : « Je sais qui est Jésus, et j’ai entendu parler de Paul. Mais vous, qui êtes-vous ? »

es.L: Pero el espíritu maligno respondió y les dijo: «A Jesús {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conozco, y a Pablo lo conozco bien; pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿quiénes {{plural_you:son|sois}}?».
es.B: El espíritu maligno les respondió: «Conozco a Jesús, y sé quién es Pablo. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿quiénes {{plural_you:son|sois}}?».
es.R: Pero el espíritu maligno les dijo: «Yo sé quién es Jesús, y sé de Pablo. Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿quiénes {{plural_you:son|sois}}?».

sw.L: Lakini yule pepo mbaya akajibu, akawaambia, "Yesu namjua, na Paulo namfahamu, lakini ninyi ni nani?"
sw.B: Yule pepo mbaya akawajibu, "Yesu namjua, na Paulo namfahamu. Lakini ninyi ni akina nani?"
sw.R: Lakini yule pepo mbaya akawaambia, "Namjua Yesu ni nani, na ninamfahamu Paulo. Lakini ninyi ni nani?"

vi.L: Nhưng tà linh đáp lại họ: "Giê-xu thì ta biết, và Phao-lô thì ta biết rõ, còn các ngươi là ai?"
vi.B: Tà linh đáp lại họ: "Giê-xu thì ta biết, Phao-lô thì ta cũng biết, nhưng các ngươi là ai?"
vi.R: Nhưng tà linh nói với họ: "Ta biết Giê-xu là ai, và ta cũng biết về Phao-lô. Còn các ngươi là ai?"

ko.L: 그러나 악한 영이 대답하여 그들에게 말했다. "예수는 내가 알고, 바울도 내가 안다. 그런데 너희는 누구냐?"
ko.B: 그러자 악한 영이 그들에게 대답했다. "나는 예수를 알고, 바울도 알고 있다. 그런데 너희는 누구냐?"
ko.R: 그러나 악한 영이 그들에게 말했다. "나는 예수가 누구인지 알고, 바울에 관해서도 알고 있다. 그런데 너희는 누구냐?"

decisions.choice: two verbs for knowing: to know Jesus, and to know about Paul
alternatives: the two verbs mean the same
decisions.reason: The spirit uses two different verbs. The first may point to knowing Jesus and his power, the second to knowing who Paul is. They may also be only a change of word.

decisions.choice: but you: stressed; they have no authority over the spirit
decisions.reason: The pronoun is set first for contrast. Jesus and Paul have authority; these men do not.

decisions.choice: je connais Jésus; je sais qui est Paul
alternatives: je connais Jésus et je connais Paul
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two different verbs (m1). French "connaître" and "savoir qui il est" keep the difference without making one sound stronger than the Greek.

decisions.choice: conozco ... lo conozco bien (L); conozco ... sé quién es (B)
decisions.reason: The spirit uses two different verbs for knowing (meaning decision on the two verbs); Spanish varies the second verb so the reader can see that the two are not the same.

decisions.choice: "알다" (L, B), "누구인지 알다" and "에 관해서도 알다" (R) for the two verbs of knowing; the spirit speaks in 해라체 with no honorific for Jesus
decisions.reason: The meaning decision sees a difference between knowing Jesus and knowing about Paul (uncertain); Korean has no pair of verbs that keeps it neatly, so Literal and Balanced vary the clause and Readable spells it out. An evil spirit does not honour Jesus.

source.text: καὶ ἐφαλόμενος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἐν ᾧ ἦν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πονηρὸν κατακυριεύσας ἀμφοτέρων ἴσχυσεν κατ’ αὐτῶν, ὥστε γυμνοὺς καὶ τετραυματισμένους ἐκφυγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου ἐκείνου.

records.literal_gloss: And having leapt the man on them, in whom was the spirit the evil, having overpowered both he prevailed against them, so that naked and wounded they fled out of the house that.

en.L: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leapt on them, and overpowering them all he prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
en.B: Then the man who had the evil spirit threw himself on them. He mastered every one of them and was too strong for them, so that they fled from that house stripped of their clothes and covered with wounds.
en.R: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them. He was too strong for all of them and beat them. They ran out of the house hurt, with their clothes torn off.

fr.L: Et l’homme en qui était l’esprit mauvais, s’étant jeté sur eux, s’étant rendu maître de tous, l’emporta sur eux, de sorte qu’ils s’enfuirent de cette maison nus et blessés.
fr.B: Alors l’homme qui avait l’esprit mauvais se jeta sur eux. Il les maîtrisa tous et fut plus fort qu’eux, si bien qu’ils s’enfuirent de cette maison dépouillés de leurs vêtements et couverts de blessures.
fr.R: Alors l’homme qui avait l’esprit mauvais leur a sauté dessus. Il était plus fort qu’eux tous, et il les a battus. Ils se sont sauvés de la maison, blessés, avec leurs vêtements arrachés.

es.L: Y el hombre en quien estaba el espíritu maligno saltó sobre ellos y, dominándolos a todos, pudo más que ellos, de modo que huyeron de aquella casa desnudos y heridos.
es.B: Entonces el hombre que tenía el espíritu maligno se lanzó sobre ellos. Los dominó a todos y pudo más que ellos, de modo que huyeron de aquella casa sin ropa y cubiertos de heridas.
es.R: Entonces el hombre que tenía el espíritu maligno saltó sobre ellos. Era más fuerte que todos ellos y les dio una paliza. Salieron corriendo de la casa, heridos y con la ropa arrancada.

sw.L: Na yule mtu aliyekuwa na pepo mbaya akawarukia, akiwashinda wote akawazidi nguvu, hata wakakimbia kutoka nyumba ile wakiwa uchi na wenye majeraha.
sw.B: Kisha yule mtu aliyekuwa na pepo mbaya akawarukia. Aliwashinda wote na kuwazidi nguvu, hata wakakimbia kutoka nyumba ile wakiwa wamevuliwa nguo na kujaa majeraha.
sw.R: Kisha yule mtu mwenye pepo mbaya akawarukia. Alikuwa na nguvu kuliko wote, akawapiga. Wakakimbia kutoka nyumba ile wakiwa wameumia, na nguo zao zimechanwa.

vi.L: Và người có tà linh ám nhảy bổ vào họ, khống chế cả bọn và thắng họ, đến nỗi họ phải trần truồng và bị thương mà chạy trốn khỏi nhà ấy.
vi.B: Rồi người bị tà linh ám nhảy xổ vào họ, khống chế tất cả và mạnh hơn họ, đến nỗi họ phải chạy trốn khỏi nhà ấy, quần áo bị lột hết và mình đầy thương tích.
vi.R: Rồi người bị tà linh ám nhảy lên tấn công họ. Ông ta mạnh hơn tất cả bọn họ và đánh họ. Họ phải chạy ra khỏi nhà ấy, bị thương và quần áo bị xé rách hết.

ko.L: 그리고 악한 영이 들린 그 사람이 그들에게 뛰어올라 모두를 제압하여 이겼다. 그래서 그들은 벗은 몸으로 상처를 입고 그 집에서 도망쳤다.
ko.B: 그러고는 악한 영이 들린 그 사람이 그들에게 달려들어 그들을 모두 제압하고 이겨 버렸다. 그래서 그들은 옷이 벗겨지고 상처를 입은 채 그 집에서 도망쳤다.
ko.R: 그러자 악한 영이 들린 사람이 그들에게 달려들었다. 그는 그들 모두보다 힘이 세서 그들을 마구 때렸다. 그들은 옷이 찢겨 벗겨지고 다친 채로 그 집에서 도망쳤다.

decisions.choice: all of them
alternatives: both of them: only two of the sons were there
decisions.reason: The word usually means "both", but in later Greek it can mean "all", and verse 14 speaks of seven sons. Some think that only two of the sons were there that day.

decisions.choice: naked: stripped, perhaps of their outer clothes
decisions.reason: The word can mean without one's outer garment (John 21:7). Either way, they fled in shame.

decisions.choice: overpowered them and prevailed against them: the spirit was far too strong for them
decisions.reason: The two verbs say the same thing twice, for force.

decisions.choice: with their clothes torn off
decisions.reason: Readable says what being stripped means here, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: τοῦτο δὲ ἐγένετο γνωστὸν πᾶσιν Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν τὴν Ἔφεσον, καὶ ἐπέπεσεν φόβος ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐμεγαλύνετο τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: This now became known to all Jews both and Greeks those inhabiting the Ephesus, and fell fear upon all them, and was being magnified the name of the Lord Jesus.

en.L: And this became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived in Ephesus, and fear fell upon them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was being magnified.
en.B: Everyone in Ephesus, Jews and Greeks alike, came to hear of this. Fear took hold of them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was more and more honored.
en.R: All the Jews and Greeks who lived in Ephesus heard about this. They were all afraid, and they gave great honor to the Lord Jesus.

fr.L: Et cela fut connu de tous, Juifs et Grecs, qui habitaient Éphèse, et la crainte tomba sur eux tous, et le nom du Seigneur Jésus était magnifié.
fr.B: Tous les habitants d’Éphèse, Juifs comme Grecs, l’apprirent. La crainte s’empara d’eux tous, et le nom du Seigneur Jésus était de plus en plus honoré.
fr.R: Tous les Juifs et tous les Grecs qui vivaient à Éphèse en ont entendu parler. Ils ont tous eu peur, et ils ont beaucoup honoré le Seigneur Jésus.

es.L: Y esto llegó a ser conocido por todos, tanto judíos como griegos, los que habitaban en Éfeso, y cayó temor sobre todos ellos, y el nombre del Señor Jesús era engrandecido.
es.B: Todos en Éfeso, judíos y griegos por igual, se enteraron de esto. El temor se apoderó de todos ellos, y el nombre del Señor Jesús era cada vez más honrado.
es.R: Todos los judíos y los griegos que vivían en Éfeso oyeron lo que había pasado. Todos tuvieron mucho miedo, y daban gran honra al Señor Jesús.

sw.L: Na jambo hili likajulikana kwa wote, Wayahudi na Wagiriki, waliokaa Efeso, na hofu ikawaangukia wote, na jina la Bwana Yesu likawa likitukuzwa.
sw.B: Watu wote wa Efeso, Wayahudi na Wagiriki pia, walisikia habari hii. Hofu ikawashika wote, na jina la Bwana Yesu likazidi kuheshimiwa.
sw.R: Wayahudi wote na Wagiriki walioishi Efeso walisikia habari hii. Wote waliogopa, wakampa Bwana Yesu heshima kubwa.

vi.L: Việc này được mọi người Do Thái và Hy Lạp sống ở Ê-phê-sô biết đến, và sự sợ hãi giáng trên tất cả họ, và danh Chúa Giê-xu được tôn cao.
vi.B: Mọi người ở Ê-phê-sô, cả người Do Thái lẫn người Hy Lạp, đều nghe biết việc này. Ai nấy đều kinh sợ, và danh Chúa Giê-xu ngày càng được tôn kính.
vi.R: Tất cả người Do Thái và người Hy Lạp sống ở Ê-phê-sô đều nghe nói về việc này. Ai nấy đều sợ hãi, và họ hết sức tôn kính Chúa Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일이 에베소에 사는 모든 유대인과 그리스 사람에게 알려졌다. 그리고 그들 모두에게 두려움이 임하였고, 주 예수의 이름이 높임을 받았다.
ko.B: 에베소에 사는 모든 사람이 유대인이든 그리스 사람이든 이 일을 알게 되었다. 그들은 모두 두려움에 사로잡혔고, 주 예수의 이름은 점점 더 높임을 받았다.
ko.R: 에베소에 사는 모든 유대인과 그리스 사람이 이 일에 관해 들었다. 그들은 모두 두려워했다. 그리고 주 예수를 크게 높였다.

decisions.choice: fear fell upon them: a sudden awe at God's power
alternatives: fear of the man with the spirit
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same words when God acts in power (5:5, 5:11; Luke 1:65).

decisions.choice: the name was magnified: the Lord Jesus himself was praised and honored
alternatives: the name became famous as a charm
decisions.reason: The name stands for the person (3:16). The verb means to make great, to praise (10:46).

decisions.choice: was being magnified: went on being honored
decisions.reason: The imperfect describes something that continued.

decisions.choice: gave great honor to the Lord Jesus
alternatives: the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified
decisions.reason: Readable says what honoring his name meant, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: πολλοί τε τῶν πεπιστευκότων ἤρχοντο ἐξομολογούμενοι καὶ ἀναγγέλλοντες τὰς πράξεις αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Many then of those having believed were coming, confessing and declaring the deeds of them.

en.L: And many of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their practices.
en.B: Many who had believed began coming forward to confess and to disclose their practices.
en.R: Many people who had believed in Jesus came and admitted the wrong things they had done. They told everyone about them.

fr.L: Et beaucoup de ceux qui avaient cru venaient, confessant et déclarant leurs pratiques.
fr.B: Beaucoup de ceux qui étaient devenus croyants venaient confesser et dévoiler leurs pratiques.
fr.R: Beaucoup de gens qui avaient cru en Jésus sont venus reconnaître le mal qu’ils avaient fait. Ils l’ont raconté à tout le monde.

es.L: Y muchos de los que habían creído venían confesando y declarando sus prácticas.
es.B: Muchos de los que habían creído venían a confesar y a dar a conocer sus prácticas.
es.R: Muchas personas que habían creído en Jesús vinieron y reconocieron las cosas malas que habían hecho. Se las contaron a todos.

sw.L: Na wengi wa wale waliokuwa wameamini walikuwa wakija, wakiungama na kuyatangaza matendo yao.
sw.B: Wengi wa wale waliokuwa wameamini walianza kuja mbele kuungama na kuyaweka wazi matendo yao.
sw.R: Watu wengi waliokuwa wamemwamini Yesu walikuja, wakakiri mambo mabaya waliyokuwa wameyafanya. Waliwaeleza watu wote mambo hayo.

vi.L: Nhiều người đã tin đến xưng nhận và thú thật những việc mình làm.
vi.B: Nhiều người đã tin Chúa lần lượt đến xưng nhận và khai ra những việc họ đã làm.
vi.R: Nhiều người đã tin Đức Giê-xu đến và thú nhận những điều sai trái họ đã làm. Họ kể cho mọi người biết những việc ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 믿게 된 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 와서 자기들의 행위를 자백하고 드러냈다.
ko.B: 믿게 된 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 앞으로 나와서, 자기들이 하던 일을 고백하고 털어놓았다.
ko.R: 예수를 믿게 된 많은 사람이 와서 자기들이 저지른 잘못을 인정했다. 그리고 그 일을 모든 사람에게 말했다.

decisions.choice: those who had believed: people already believers
decisions.reason: The perfect participle describes people who had come to believe before this. Some of them had still not given up their old practices.

decisions.choice: practices: their deeds, here most likely their magic
decisions.reason: The word means deeds or practices. Verse 19 shows that the practices were magic.

decisions.choice: were coming: one after another
decisions.reason: The imperfect describes something that went on happening.

decisions.choice: the wrong things they had done
decisions.reason: Readable says that the practices were wrong, as verse 19 shows.

source.text: ἱκανοὶ δὲ τῶν τὰ περίεργα πραξάντων συνενέγκαντες τὰς βίβλους κατέκαιον ἐνώπιον πάντων· καὶ συνεψήφισαν τὰς τιμὰς αὐτῶν καὶ εὗρον ἀργυρίου μυριάδας πέντε.

records.literal_gloss: Many now of those the magic arts having practiced, having brought together the books, were burning [them] before all; and they counted up the prices of them and found [it] of silver myriads five.

en.L: And many of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books together and burned [them] before everyone; and they counted up their value and found [it to be] 50,000 [pieces] of silver.
en.B: A good number of those who had practiced magic collected their books and burned them where everyone could see. When the value of the books was added up, it came to 50,000 silver coins.
en.R: Many of those who had used magic brought their magic books and burned them in front of everyone. They added up how much the books were worth. It came to 50,000 silver coins. That was a very large amount of money.

fr.L: Et bon nombre de ceux qui avaient pratiqué la magie, ayant rassemblé leurs livres, [les] brûlaient devant tous ; et ils en calculèrent la valeur et trouvèrent 50 000 [pièces] d’argent.
fr.B: Un bon nombre de ceux qui s’étaient livrés à la magie rassemblèrent leurs livres et les brûlèrent sous les yeux de tous. On en calcula la valeur : elle atteignait 50 000 pièces d’argent.
fr.R: Beaucoup de ceux qui avaient pratiqué la magie ont apporté leurs livres de magie et les ont brûlés devant tout le monde. Ils ont calculé combien ces livres valaient. Cela faisait 50 000 pièces d’argent. C’était une somme énorme.

es.L: Y bastantes de los que habían practicado la magia, juntando los libros, [los] quemaban delante de todos; y calcularon su precio y hallaron [que era de] 50 000 [monedas] de plata.
es.B: Un buen número de los que habían practicado la magia reunieron sus libros y los quemaron a la vista de todos. Cuando se calculó el valor de los libros, sumaba 50 000 monedas de plata.
es.R: Muchos de los que habían practicado la magia trajeron sus libros de magia y los quemaron delante de todos. Calcularon cuánto valían los libros, y llegaba a 50 000 monedas de plata. Era muchísimo dinero.

sw.L: Na wengi wa wale waliokuwa wakifanya uchawi walikusanya vitabu vyao, wakawa wakiviteketeza mbele ya wote; nao wakahesabu thamani yake, wakaona [ni] vipande 50,000 vya fedha.
sw.B: Wengi wa wale waliokuwa wamefanya uchawi walikusanya vitabu vyao, wakaviteketeza mahali ambapo kila mtu angeweza kuona. Thamani ya vitabu hivyo ilipohesabiwa, ilifikia sarafu 50,000 za fedha.
sw.R: Wengi wa wale waliokuwa wamefanya uchawi walileta vitabu vyao vya uchawi, wakavichoma moto mbele ya watu wote. Walihesabu thamani ya vitabu hivyo. Ilifikia sarafu 50,000 za fedha. Hizo zilikuwa fedha nyingi sana.

vi.L: Nhiều người đã hành nghề phù phép đem sách vở mình đến đốt trước mặt mọi người; người ta tính giá sách ấy và thấy là năm vạn đồng bạc.
vi.B: Khá nhiều người đã làm nghề phù phép gom sách của họ lại và đốt trước mặt mọi người. Khi tính giá những sách ấy, người ta thấy lên đến năm mươi nghìn đồng bạc.
vi.R: Nhiều người đã từng làm phép thuật đem sách phép thuật của mình đến và đốt đi trước mặt mọi người. Họ tính xem những sách ấy đáng giá bao nhiêu. Tổng cộng là năm mươi nghìn đồng bạc. Đó là một số tiền rất lớn.

ko.L: 그리고 마술을 행하던 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 그 책들을 모아 와서 모든 사람 앞에서 불살랐다. 그리고 그 값을 계산해 보니 은 5만이었다.
ko.B: 마술을 하던 사람들 가운데 여러 사람이 자기들의 책을 모아다가 모든 사람이 보는 앞에서 불태웠다. 그 책값을 모두 계산해 보니 은화 5만 개나 되었다.
ko.R: 마술을 하던 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 마술 책을 가져와서 모든 사람 앞에서 불태웠다. 그들은 그 책들의 값이 얼마나 되는지 계산해 보았다. 모두 은화 5만 개나 되었다. 그것은 아주 큰 돈이었다.

decisions.choice: magic arts: sorcery, the practice of magic
decisions.reason: The word means things done with too much curiosity, and so magic.

decisions.choice: the books: scrolls of spells
decisions.reason: Ephesus was famous for magic. Spells known as "Ephesian letters" were written and worn as charms.

decisions.choice: 50,000 pieces of silver: a huge sum, though its value today cannot be fixed
decisions.reason: The silver coin was most likely the drachma, about a day's pay for a laborer (compare the denarius in Matthew 20:2). So the books were worth something like the wages of 50,000 days of work. No modern equivalent is given, because the value cannot be known exactly.

decisions.choice: burned: kept burning them, one after another
decisions.reason: The imperfect pictures the burning going on.

decisions.choice: That was a very large amount of money.
decisions.reason: Readable says what the number meant, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: uchawi
decisions.reason: Sorcery, the practice of magic (meaning decision), "uchawi" as the term list has it for magic; the books were scrolls of spells.

decisions.choice: "năm vạn đồng bạc" (L); "năm mươi nghìn đồng bạc" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Numbers in words in running text, as the style guide sets; Literal keeps the Greek count of myriads with the old word "vạn" (ten thousand). The English has no units span here, so neither does Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "마술" for the magic arts; "은 5만" (L), "은화 5만 개" (B, R), with no units span
decisions.reason: The value of the coins today cannot be fixed (meaning decision), and the English has no setting here, so neither does the Korean. The number is in figures, as large numbers are in Korean (style guide, section 5).

source.text: οὕτως κατὰ κράτος τοῦ κυρίου ὁ λόγος ηὔξανεν καὶ ἴσχυεν.

records.literal_gloss: Thus with might of the Lord the word was growing and prevailing.

en.L: Thus with might the word of the Lord was growing and prevailing.
en.B: So with great power the word of the Lord kept growing and gaining strength.
en.R: In this way the word of the Lord kept spreading, and it showed its great power.

fr.L: Ainsi, avec force, la parole du Seigneur croissait et l’emportait.
fr.B: C’est ainsi que, avec une grande puissance, la parole du Seigneur ne cessait de grandir et de s’affermir.
fr.R: De cette façon, la parole du Seigneur se répandait de plus en plus, et elle montrait sa grande puissance.

es.L: Así, con poder, la palabra del Señor crecía y prevalecía.
